findings.statement: Not extracted. The paper names the genomes used but the supplementary table listing them was not read, and no data date is given in the main text.
findings.source_says: paper-fulltext.xml, Materials and Methods: "We obtained a list of Brassicales reference genome assemblies from NCBI Genome ( https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/data-hub/genome/ ) (( 54 ))"; reference 54: "E.W. Sayers et al. , Genome. NCBI. https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/data-hub/genome . Accessed 2 June 2023."
findings.fix: The list of Brassicales reference genome assemblies was obtained from NCBI Genome, which the paper cites as accessed 2 June 2023. The supplementary table naming the genomes was not read.

summary: Reliable apart from the training cutoff. Architecture, parameter count, licence, revision and the CLI commands match the PNAS paper, config, API response and package docs, but the paper does date its genome list (NCBI Genome, accessed 2 June 2023), which the page says it does not.
